scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mylyfe/domain && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @mylyfe/api" "npm run dev -w @mylyfe/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mylyfe/domain && npm run build -w @mylyfe/api && npm run build -w @mylyfe/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mylyfe/domain && npm run test -w @mylyfe/web && npm run test -w @mylyfe/mobile && npm run test -w @mylyfe/api
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @mylyfe/domain && npm run test:coverage -w @mylyfe/web && npm run test:coverage -w @mylyfe/mobile && npm run test:coverage -w @mylyfe/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mylyfe/domain && npm run build -w @mylyfe/domain && npm run typecheck -w @mylyfe/api && npm run typecheck -w @mylyfe/web && npm run typecheck -w @mylyfe/secretary
